wish: someone should make a recipe database with a shopping list generator
spec:
Keeps your recipes (name plus ingredients, one per line) on this device and turns the meals you pick for the week into one merged shopping list.
Save recipes, tap + for each time you will cook one this week, then tick items off in the shop or copy the list.
It does not import recipes from websites, sync between devices, or convert cups to grams.
notes: Quantities merge across recipes by ingredient name and unit (g/kg and ml/l combine). Lines without a number are listed once.
